extraction.name: EuroSAT
extraction.description: A dataset based on Sentinel-2 satellite images for land use and land cover classification, covering 13 spectral bands, 10 classes, and 27,000 labeled and geo-referenced images.
extraction.creator: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Satellite images were downloaded from Sentinel-2A via Amazon S3 for cities covered in the European Urban Atlas, selecting images with low cloud level, and then 27,000 georeferenced labeled 64x64 image patches were created and manually checked.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Sentinel-2A satellite images associated with cities covered in the European Urban Atlas, downloaded via Amazon S3.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: Images were recorded all over the year; example source imagery includes acquisitions from December 2015 to March 2017.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Image patches of size 64x64 were extracted; images with low cloud level were selected; mislabeled images and images full of snow or ice were sorted out; atmospheric correction was not applied; lower-resolution bands were upsampled to 10 meters per pixel using cubic-spline interpolation for band evaluation.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset contains labeled image patches based on 10 land use and land cover classes chosen from classes visible at 10 meters per pixel and frequently covered by the European Urban Atlas; all images were manually checked multiple times and ground truth was corrected by removing mislabeled images and images full of snow or ice.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Ground truth was corrected through repeated manual checking, removing mislabeled images and images full of snow or ice.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The paper discusses applications in agriculture, disaster recovery, climate change, urban development, environmental monitoring, nature protection, sustainable development, and improving geographical maps.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset distribution is influenced by the number of represented cities per country in the European Urban Atlas, and some classes have low positive correlation with each other, especially agricultural classes and residential versus industrial buildings.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset has not received atmospheric correction, which can result in images with a color cast; a 64x64 patch-based classifier does not allow finely graduated per-pixel segmentation; the classifier sometimes confuses agricultural land classes as well as highway and river.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and benchmarking deep neural networks for land use and land cover classification, as well as real-world Earth observation applications such as land use and land cover change detection and improving geographical maps.
